title: Open-Source Enneagram Scorer & React App (GitHub, MIT)
description: Free MIT-licensed JavaScript Enneagram scorer (score.js) and React + TypeScript starter app: 36 items, live browser scorer demo, and tie-preserving rules.
pill: Developer resource · runnable starter & JS scorer
h1: Open-source Enneagram test & scorer (React + TypeScript + JS).
dek: Download the zero-dependency MIT JavaScript scorer (score.js), try the live 36-item scoring demo, or run the complete Vite + React + TypeScript starter app.
lede: Build an Enneagram assessment locally without rewriting pagination, keyboard accessibility, or tie-preserving scoring arithmetic. Below you get both the complete MIT-licensed React + TypeScript starter project and the standalone zero-dependency JavaScript scorer (score.js) for Node or browsers—plus an interactive scoring widget right on this page.
answer: Download score.js + questions.json for a standalone Node/browser scorer, or grab enneagram-react-typescript.zip (npm ci && npm run dev) for a complete 6-page React + TypeScript Enneagram UI. Pass 36 integers (1–5) to score() to return nine raw totals (4–20) and all tied leaders without forcing an arbitrary winner. The code and synthetic demo inputs are MIT-licensed; the live 36-item test at /tests/enneagram carries separate OEPS upstream item terms.

sections.h2: Download the standalone JS scorer or full React + TypeScript starter.
sections.html:
Pick either the full React + TypeScript starter ZIP or the dependency-free CommonJS/browser files:

DownloadWhat it includes
enneagram-react-typescript.zipFull Vite + React + TypeScript starter with accessible fieldsets, validation, lockfile, and public/score.js.
score.jsZero-dependency MIT JavaScript scorer for Node and browsers: strict input validation, 9 totals (4–20), and explicit tie reporting.
questions.json36 synthetic demo inputs, type keys (4 per type), and scale metadata.
README.md & LICENSE-code.txtIntegration examples, API contract, and MIT license boundary.

To run the React starter locally with Node.js 22.12+, extract the archive and run:

cd enneagram-react-typescript
npm ci
npm run dev

Serve the built dist/ folder over HTTP (never open the raw HTML file over file://). Want to take the live 36-question OEPS test without code? Visit /tests/enneagram.

sections.h2: Try the JavaScript scorer live in your browser.
sections.html:
Edit the 36-item array or load a preset below. This widget parses and scores numbers locally using score.js without sending or storing answers.

Exactly 36 whole numbers from 1 to 5. Examples are synthetic test inputs.

sections.h2: Use the scorer in Node or a browser (with a TypeScript boundary).
sections.html:
In Node CommonJS, load score.js directly:

const { score } = require('./score.js'); const answers = Array(36).fill(3); answers.fill(5, 16, 20); // Type 5 items (indices 16-19) console.log(score(answers)); // leaders: [5], dominantType: 5, topScore: 20

In the React + TypeScript starter, public/score.js loads once and src/scorer.ts wraps the single canonical implementation:

interface Score {
  version: string;
  scores: Record<string, number>;
  topScore: number;
  leaders: number[];
  tied: boolean;
  dominantType: number | null;
}
FieldContract
versionagenttune-enneagram-36-v1 identifying the 36-input 9-group contract.
scoresRaw integer totals (4–20) keyed by Enneagram type 1–9 (no reversed items).
topScoreHighest raw integer total across the nine groups.
leadersSorted array of every type sharing topScore.
tiedtrue whenever two or more types share topScore.
dominantTypeUnique leader integer 1–9, or null when tied.

The scorer rejects incomplete or sparse arrays, strings, fractions, and values outside 1–5 so missing responses never coerce silently to neutral.

Each of the nine groups has four inputs and a raw score from 4 to 20. A result of 16/20 is a raw total, not an 80th percentile or an 80% probability of being that type. None of the 36 items are reverse-scored.

When two or more groups share the maximum total, the app lists every leader and leaves dominantType set to null. Answering Neutral (3) to all 36 items gives all nine groups 12 points; the result screen explicitly reports a nine-way tie and displays all nine totals instead of picking Type 1 by array order.

This matters in empirical testing: in our September 2026 AI archive, Opus 5.5 had 65 tied Enneagram administrations out of 100 and Fable 5.1 had 44. Forcing a single winner hides real ties.

sections.h2: Make the questionnaire usable with a keyboard.
sections.html:
Each item is rendered as the <legend> of a native <fieldset>, and each response option is a labeled radio button. Keyboard users can tab between groups and arrow through options using standard browser controls. The starter displays six items per page and preserves selections when navigating back.

Submitting an incomplete page identifies the first unanswered item and moves focus to its first radio control. Advancing to the next page or the results view moves focus to the new section heading. Validation messages use an alert region, and the score table uses semantic row and column headers.

• src/App.tsx controls six-page pagination, radio state, validation and the result view.
  • src/styles.css controls layout, color contrast and focus rings.
  • src/questions.json holds the 36 synthetic demo inputs and group mapping.
  • src/scorer.ts declares the TypeScript types and calls the global scorer.
  • public/score.js provides the dependency-free scoring implementation.

If you replace the synthetic demo controls in src/questions.json with a licensed questionnaire, verify the instrument’s redistribution terms and bump the version identifier so scores from different instruments are never mixed.

The developer bundle in /resources/enneagram/ provides MIT-licensed JavaScript arithmetic and 36 synthetic demo controls for testing form state and tie handling. The separate interactive questionnaire at /tests/enneagram and versioned definitions in /resources/scoring/questions.json use AgentTune’s 36-item adaptation of material attributed to the Open-Source Psychometrics Project’s OEPS (whose live upstream instrument has 54 items).

The MIT code license applies to the original JavaScript implementation and synthetic inputs; it does not relicense third-party questionnaire wording. Review instrument-rights.json and the historical provenance record before redistributing questionnaire text.

faq.q: Does the starter ZIP include OEPS question text?
faq.a: No. The starter ships with 36 original synthetic controls in src/questions.json so you can test pagination, validation, and tie rendering under the MIT license. Verify instrument rights before adding third-party questionnaire wording.

faq.q: Where can I take the full interactive Enneagram test?
faq.a: Take the 36-item Enneagram questionnaire directly in your browser at /tests/enneagram, or choose communication preferences without a test in the generator.
